title: Snap
description: This plugin adds a command that will snap the player to the center of a block and with snapped look direction of 90 degrees.
body:
This plugin adds one simple command:
```
/snap
```
It is mainly used for server developers, to quickly snap your coordinates and look direction, to for example setting spawn points.
You can also type
```
/snap precise
```
to teleport to half blocks and 22.5 degrees of sight.
